headlines.title: Floods, landslides kill 56 in India and 14 in Nepal - reuters.com
Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
Nepal’s floods expose issues with climate-disaster funding — firmer policies are needed fast
2 Killed, 10 Missing After Avalanche Strikes Nepal's Himlung Himal Peak
Avalanche in Nepal leaves 2 dead, several missing

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Floods and landslides have killed 14 people in Nepal. [1]
An avalanche on Nepal's Himlung Himal Peak has left 2 dead and 10 missing. [4]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR NEPAL
The deadly floods and landslides in Nepal highlight the need for firmer climate-disaster funding policies, even as the country has a net energy import dependency of 0%. [3][E2]

KEY RISKS
The government travel advisory for Nepal is Exercise Increased Caution, indicating ongoing risks to travelers from natural disasters like floods and avalanches. [E1]

WATCH ITEMS
The search for the 10 missing climbers after the avalanche on Himlung Himal Peak is unresolved. [4]
